subject: CLAIM c6t-rca-opus #3: nord2_metal_bridge.c fault diagnostics (wait_pending/n2mb_wait_seq/jm_submit WAIT + new fault_report helper + 1 field)
body: Diagnostic-only: when the bridge breaks on a failed job, request the WAIT_SEQ/WAIT fault_info struct (kernel already fills it: JS status, ctx MMU fault_status/address) and emit ONE NORD2_METAL fault line via SEL_LOG (max 4/bridge) with the failed job's handles/VA ranges from recent[] and which BO holds the fault address (or 'released'). No kernel change, no behaviour change on success paths except a 32-byte struct-out on WAIT_SEQ. Needed because the C6t log cannot say which job/fault type broke the bridge.
